cond_0001.intro:
The primary focus of this role will be shepherding new programs and features from start to finish by partnering closely with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to delight your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. Ultimately, you will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, using your willingness to roll up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0001.requirements:

Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful and innovative products
Leadership and communication. Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Proficient in JIRA
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams

Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience

cond_0026.intro:
We are looking for a Business Analyst/Product Owner to join our team.
Note: No C2C or sponsorship will be provided.
cond_0026.responsibilities:
The primary focus of this role is owning new programs and features from start to finish by engaging directly with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will lead development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to deliver value to your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will drive design thinking while executing cross-functionally to resolve problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) for your program's customers. You will hold both tactical and strategic responsibilities, rolling up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives.
What You'll Do:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Own and develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and directing prioritization with other Product Managers against all platform feature development
Engage directly with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and drive feature development to completion
Apply user research and user experience best practices to iteratively deliver mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Build and maintain working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and deliver progress reports
Lead internal stakeholders through review and feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to the department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Use product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with department/company goals
Identify new data platform use cases and set product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Pursue continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0026.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful products
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Proficient in JIRA
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Preferred Requirements:
Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus

The primary focus of this role will be shepherding new programs and features from start to finish by partnering closely with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to delight your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. Ultimately, you will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, using your willingness to roll up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp data platform concepts and the logic behind product decisions.
cond_0058.responsibilities:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:**
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0058.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful and innovative products
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Proficient in JIRA
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Leadership and communication. Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Preferred Requirements**
Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus

Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space

Love advancing science for patient benefit

cond_0240.intro:
The primary focus of this role is shepherding new programs and features from start to finish by partnering closely with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices and staying in regular contact with your customers to address their needs efficiently. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. You will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, working hands-on to achieve the company's objectives.
cond_0240.responsibilities:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner daily with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Build and maintain working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Connect regularly with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to the department and broader organization to socialize the platform's capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Share best practices with the team regularly as part of ongoing self-improvement as a Product Manager
cond_0240.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful products
Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills — this is an extremely cross-functional role with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Proficient in JIRA
Preferred Requirements
Experience in Figma, Adobe XD
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus

cond_0392.intro:
We are looking for a Business Analyst/Product Owner to join our team at a global biopharmaceutical client. The primary focus of this role will be shepherding new programs and features from start to finish by partnering closely with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to delight your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. Ultimately, you will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, using your willingness to roll up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with product management and data platform work.
cond_0392.responsibilities:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
cond_0392.requirements:
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful and innovative products
Leadership and communication. Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Proficient in JIRA
Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to delight your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. Ultimately, you will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, using your willingness to roll up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives. Most people become stronger in this kind of product management work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0419.responsibilities:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0419.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful and innovative products
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Proficient in JIRA
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Leadership and communication. Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Preferred Requirements
Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus
If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application or at any point in the hiring process, please contact us at info@primarytalentpartners.com

The primary focus of this role will be shepherding new programs and features from start to finish by partnering closely with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to delight your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. Ultimately, you will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, using your willingness to roll up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives.
cond_0505.responsibilities:
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0505.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful and innovative products
Leadership and communication. Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Proficient in JIRA
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Preferred Requirements
Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus

Note: No C2C or sponsorship will be provided!
cond_0514.responsibilities:
The primary focus of this role will be shepherding new programs and features from start to finish by partnering closely with end users, Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Product Management (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.), User Experience & User Research, Computer Science, or related fields, with demonstrated experience shipping new products from conception to launch.
You will support the development of the Client's [Product name masked] by applying Product Management best practices to delight your customers in the most efficient way possible. You will leverage design thinking while collaborating cross-functionally to improve the problem areas (data search, data consumption, etc.) of your program's customers. Ultimately, you will have both tactical and strategic responsibilities, using your willingness to roll up your sleeves to achieve the company's objectives.
What You'll Do
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0514.requirements:
Minimum of 5 years' experience in Product Management delivering successful and innovative products
Leadership and communication. Proven ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including the executive level
Proficient in JIRA
Experience in Figma, Adobe Xd
Experience with data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Academic background (bachelor's degree) or equivalent work experience in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering
Experience working with agile development teams
Experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Strong communication and partnership skills – this will be an extremely cross-functional role, with more than a handful of stakeholder teams
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering experience is a plus
cond_0514.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0514.workplace_support: Our workplace is designed to support different ways of working and different stages of life and career. We provide flexibility so employees can do their best work while balancing collaboration, wellbeing, and personal responsibilities.

cond_0560.intro: We are looking for a Business Analyst/Product Owner to join our team.
cond_0560.responsibilities:
What You'll Do**
Deeply understand core problem spaces, data use cases, pain points, and processes within the Research space
Develop an overarching multi-year enterprise-level roadmap with associated milestones and objectives that informs and aligns product stakeholders (IT, Executives, etc.)
Deeply understand the Data Platform's architecture and technology to drive from current to expected future state in a timely manner
Act as Agile Product Owner for your remit, breaking down epics into consumable user stories/tasks, continuously grooming the backlog, and partnering with other Product Managers to prioritize against all platform feature development
Partner with the development team to understand technical constraints, level of effort, remove blockers, and guide feature development to completion
Utilize user research and user experience best practices to iteratively develop delightful mockups/prototypes that are consumable by end users and engineers alike
Balance tradeoffs nimbly across experience, top/bottom line, regulatory risk, and concurrent programs
Establish working relationships with project Stakeholders to gather input, review milestones, and provide progress reports
Partner with internal stakeholders to socialize and gather feedback on new prototypes and features
Present readouts to department and broader organization to evangelize and socialize the platforms' capabilities (current and future state)
Utilize product metrics and OKRs to make informed decisions and align quarterly goals with the department/company goals
Explore new data platform use cases and inform product strategy and roadmap for data, search, and AI/[Product name masked] features
Strive for continuous self-improvement as a Product Manager, sharing best practices with the team regularly
You'll Love This Job If You:**
Love working on internal platforms
Love advancing science for patient benefit
Love being an expert in the behind-the-scenes platform / data engineering / infrastructure
Love digging into the problem space and use case details
Thrive in environments of high complexity and high impact
Thrive in working with technical teams and leadership
cond_0560.requirements:
Minimum Requirements**
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in Product Management delivering successful products
Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, economics, or engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Proven track record of working collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members, including at the executive level, with exceptional communication and leadership abilities
Strong command of JIRA
Substantial experience working with agile development teams
Extensive experience defining product requirements and using data and metrics to determine outcomes
Deep knowledge of data infrastructure / platform / back-end / data engineering
Strong customer empathy, with an ability to transform complex data and customer insights into a prioritized roadmap
Exceptional communication and partnership skills — this is a highly cross-functional role with multiple stakeholder teams
Preferred Requirements**
Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD
Multiple years of pharmaceutical and/or bio-tech industry experience
Entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset
Data Engineering expertise is a plus
